parameters.query:
-- One email per sale order and company (and one per request for any other event type).
-- Recipients: ADMINs of the request's company only (user_companies.role), fail-closed by id_company.
WITH p AS (
    SELECT pa.id, pa.id_company, pa.tipo_evento, pa.payload, pa.solicitado_por_email, pa.fecha_solicitud,
           pa.sale_order_id, so.order_code,
           cl.rfid_siniiga, cl.numero_fuego, cl.electronic_rfid, cl.category, cl.species
    FROM pending_authorizations pa
    JOIN cattle_livestock cl ON cl.id = pa.livestock_id AND cl.tenant_id = pa.id_company
    LEFT JOIN sale_orders so ON so.id = pa.sale_order_id
    WHERE pa.estado = 'PENDIENTE'
      AND pa.notified_at IS NULL
),
g AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(p.sale_order_id::text, p.id::text)                         AS group_key,
           p.id_company,
           p.tipo_evento,
           max(p.order_code)                                                   AS order_code,
           string_agg(DISTINCT p.solicitado_por_email, ', ')                   AS solicitado_por,
           to_char((min(p.fecha_solicitud) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City',
                   'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')                                       AS fecha_solicitud_cdmx,
           to_char((min(p.fecha_solicitud) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City',
                   'DD/MM/YYYY')                                               AS vence_dia_cdmx,
           string_agg(p.id::text, ',' ORDER BY p.id)                           AS request_ids,
           count(*)                                                            AS total,
           jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
               'request_id',      p.id,
               'rfid_siniiga',    p.rfid_siniiga,
               'numero_fuego',    p.numero_fuego,
               'electronic_rfid', p.electronic_rfid,
               'category',        COALESCE(p.category, p.species),
               'guia_transito',   p.payload->>'guia_transito',
               'fecha_evento',    p.payload->>'fecha_evento',
               'causa_mortandad', p.payload->>'causa_mortandad',
               'descripcion',     p.payload->>'descripcion'
           ) ORDER BY p.payload->>'guia_transito', p.rfid_siniiga)            AS animales
    FROM p
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT g.*,
       c.company_name,
       (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT u.email, ',')
          FROM user_companies uc
          JOIN users u ON u.email = uc.email
         WHERE uc.id_company = g.id_company
           AND uc.role = 'ADMIN'
           AND uc.is_active = true
           AND u.is_active = true)                                             AS admin_emails
FROM g
JOIN companys c ON c.id_company = g.id_company
ORDER BY g.id_company, g.order_code NULLS LAST;

UPDATE pending_authorizations
SET notified_at = now()
WHERE id = ANY(string_to_array($1, ',')::uuid[])
  AND estado = 'PENDIENTE'
  AND notified_at IS NULL;
